title: Walmart completes its acquisition of TV advertising company Vibe.co | TechCrunch
summary: Walmart announced on Tuesday that it has completed its acquisition of self-service streaming TV advertising platform Vibe.co. The acquisition, which was first announced in June, brings Vibe.co into Walmart Connect, the retailer’s connected TV advertising platform.
